title: AWS Community Day Delhi 2024
summary: A day-long community-run conference at IIT Delhi: 17 speakers, hands-on workshops and networking for Delhi NCR's AWS community.
overview:
AWS Community Day Delhi 2024 was a day-long, community-driven event that celebrated learning, collaboration, and innovation with AWS technologies.

Cloud enthusiasts, developers, students, IT professionals, and business leaders came together for an extraordinary experience of knowledge sharing and networking.
recap:
### Who attended

AWS Community Day Delhi 2024 brought together developers, architects, cloud enthusiasts, IT professionals, students, and business leaders from diverse backgrounds.

The event catered to anyone passionate about AWS technologies, whether beginners or seasoned experts.

Hundreds of attendees connected, shared knowledge, and built lasting relationships within the AWS community.

### The event

This day-long event was filled with immersive experiences, from hands-on workshops to deep-dive technical sessions.

Attendees explored the latest trends and innovative implementations guided by AWS veterans, experts, and industry leaders.

It truly reflected the community spirit — created by the community, for the community — delivering highly relevant and engaging content.

### Why it mattered

The event reignited passion for cloud technology and helped accelerate AWS journeys for many attendees.

With practical insights, real-world use cases, and success stories, participants left equipped with knowledge they could directly apply in their businesses or careers.

From networking opportunities to exclusive AWS goodies, the event offered memorable professional and personal takeaways.
